title: What Scripture Actually Says About Sleep (It's Not Laziness)
caption:
Most guys treat sleep like the thing you cut when life gets serious.

Scripture treats it differently. Every night you lie down, you're admitting you're not God. He doesn't sleep. You do. That's not weakness. That's trust.

Grinding till 2 AM isn't devotion. Elijah got a nap and a meal before he got a word. Jesus slept through a storm.

So guard the last hour. Phone across the room. Same lights-out every night. The man who can't go to bed can't get up either.

"In peace I will both lie down and sleep; for you alone, O Lord, make me dwell in safety." Psalm 4:8

Save this for the night you're tempted to stay up. Send it to the brother running on fumes.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #sleep #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
